data.one_liner: Flutter UI package to quickly display a settings screen with user cards and item groups.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-built UI components like SettingsGroup, SettingsItem, and various user card widgets (BigUserCard, SmallUserCard, SimpleUserCard) to construct a clean settings screen in a Flutter app.
use_when: You need to quickly build a settings page with standard options and profile cards.
You want consistent layout components for user profiles and settings rows.
avoid_when: You require a complex automated preference management framework tied to local storage.
Your design system heavily deviates from the default styling provided by the widgets.
strengths: Easy to set up and start using immediately.
Includes helpful user card components alongside settings groups.
weaknesses: Limited to specific pre-defined UI components for settings.
Does not include built-in persistent storage or state management for user settings.
